WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.category, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) / SUM(n.net_sales), 1) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 6
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-11-30'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.member_key, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.standard_cost, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id
LIMIT 24

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c, MIN(sales_line_id) keep_id, MIN(sale_date) sd, MIN(store_key) sk,
         COUNT(DISTINCT sale_date||'|'||store_key||'|'||product_key||'|'||quantity||'|'||net_amount||'|'||standard_cost) AS distinct_content
  FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT MIN(sd) min_date, MAX(sd) max_date, COUNT(*) dup_keys, SUM(c-1) extra_rows, MAX(c) max_c, MAX(distinct_content) max_distinct_content,
       COUNT(DISTINCT sk) n_store_keys
FROM d

           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost

    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'

SELECT cp.category AS as_is_cat, n.cat_asof AS as_was_cat, cp.subcategory AS as_is_sub, n.sub_asof AS as_was_sub,
       COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales-n.cost),2) AS gm
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 6
  AND (cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') OR n.cat_asof IN ('Garden','Electrical'))

SELECT cp.category, 
  COUNT(*) AS lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_cost,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_cost,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.net_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.quantity <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_qty,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.net_amount <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(f.standard_cost - f.quantity * p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cost_mismatch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost > f.net_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cost_gt_net,
  MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_load,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.channel_code='WB' OR s.store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-02' AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') AND s.store_id<>999
GROUP BY 1
